name: @blueyerobotics/protocol-definitions
description: TypeScript definitions for Blueye Robotics protocols

scripts.generate: rm -rf out && mkdir -p out && protoc protobuf_definitions/*.proto --plugin=./node_modules/.bin/protoc-gen-ts_proto --proto_path=protobuf_definitions --ts_proto_out=./out --ts_proto_opt=outputIndex=true --ts_proto_opt=globalThisPolyfill=true --ts_proto_opt=useExactTypes=false --ts_proto_opt=esModuleInterop=true --ts_proto_opt=importSuffix=.js
